text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A after a large gain felt satisfying, but I should make future trades based on expected returns and risk, not the pleasure of locking in gains.","Losses feel especially painful, so I should reassess each holding objectively rather than let discomfort keep me from acting when the investment case changes.","With few observations and little trading, I should not overreact to short-term account swings; I’ll stay diversified, take a long-term view, and trade selectively."]}
